---
title: "GET /tx/:txid/hex"
---

Returns the raw transaction in hex.

This method will use `10` [Compute Units](/nodeapi/about/billing).

***

## **Parameters**

**`txid`**- transaction hash, required.

Example: `92e61d56a3d79fd6b2fc53d4577f51faa61485e0165eae746a6f3ded5b994655`

## Returns

Returns the raw transaction in hex.

```text wrap

```

<CodeGroup>

```bash title="mainnet"
curl https://mainnet.bitcoin.validationcloud.io/v1/<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>/tx/92e61d56a3d79fd6b2fc53d4577f51faa61485e0165eae746a6f3ded5b994655/hex \
 -X GET
```

```bash title="testnet"
curl https://testnet.bitcoin.validationcloud.io/v1/<YOUR_API_KEY_HERE>/tx/92e61d56a3d79fd6b2fc53d4577f51faa61485e0165eae746a6f3ded5b994655/hex \
 -X GET
```

</CodeGroup>
